description: This file defines the LeavePeriodModel class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. The class implements serialization logic for LeavePeriod data transfer objects (DTOs) by utilizing traits and interfaces for normalizing data, and it sets up attributes related to leave period start and end dates.

classes.name: LeavePeriodModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing and normalizing leave period data for the leave plugin, utilizing traits and implementing the Normalizable interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a LeavePeriod DTO and configures filters and attribute mappings.
